Vendored gesture and canvas reference code from `doublelam/react-native-free-canvas`
version 2.1.0, commit `6605b6f0ff357928e2f8f0a7b8c1b1ce1a4a9979`.

Source: https://github.com/doublelam/react-native-free-canvas/tree/6605b6f0ff357928e2f8f0a7b8c1b1ce1a4a9979
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

The library source is retained here as the required integration reference. The
executable `src/editor/useEditorGestureController.ts` adapts its simultaneous
pan/pinch controller for Cutout's drawing callback, focal zoom, independent
two-finger pan, and pointer cancellation. The Expo example and built artifacts
are intentionally not included.
